info.name: raw-print agent
info.description:
Sample requests for the local raw-print agent. The agent listens on http://localhost:9100 by default (set by PORT in .env).

Set the `baseUrl` collection variable if you changed the port.

The main endpoint is POST /print — a multipart/form-data upload of one or more files plus a `jobs` field that pairs each uploaded filename to a printer name.

request.description: Lists installed printer names. Use these exact names in the `jobs` field of POST /print. Returns { "printers": [ ... ] }.

formdata.description: The file to print. Select a file from disk (e.g. receipt.pdf). Its filename must match a `file` entry in `jobs`.
JSON array pairing each uploaded filename to a printer. One entry per file.

request.description:
Print one file to one printer.

Steps:
1. In the Body tab, on the `files` row, click the file selector and choose your document.
2. Make sure the filename you selected exactly matches the `file` value inside `jobs` (edit `jobs` if needed).
3. Replace "Printer A" with a real printer name from GET /printers.

Success: { "ok": true, "printed": [ { "file": "receipt.pdf", "printer": "Printer A" } ] }

formdata.description: One { file, printer } entry per uploaded file. Each `file` must match an uploaded filename.

request.description:
Print several files in one request, sending each to its own printer. Add or remove `files` rows to match the number of `jobs` entries — the agent requires exactly one job per uploaded file.

Alternative to `jobs`: you can instead send a `printers` field as a positional JSON array of printer names, e.g. ["Printer A","Label Printer"], matched to files in upload order. `jobs` (matched by filename) is recommended.
